scope: Actual original map terrain, Candle body shader and native-verified shared load/update/render records; near-Candle camera, enabled edits, ignition/elapsed state, transform edits, resize and source preservation. Whole Flame.Load/Unload and verified motion/light prefix with explicit editor JS expf/powf and rand31; resource-ready Candle flame events. Flame Update interaction/audio remainder, billboards and actual audio/effect/reward dispatch pending. Linux software Vulkan; no original-game/device acceptance.

candles.scope: Original Candle GLSL/body mesh and native-verified whole load/update/render/ignition plus whole Flame.Load operate on shared records. Original primary FlameBarn sprite subregion and camera-facing SpriteRenderer vertices feed original Flame GLSL into shared-depth transparent color/log-depth stage. Editor caller services supply white unoccluded color, wind, clock, mathematical rsqrt estimate, frustum and distance sorting; native sinf/hardware-rsqrt are independently replayed in oracle only. Mesh observation/template setup, deterministic rand31, BVH/JS libm, scratch/GPU and local dispatch queues are editor services. Full FlameBarn, glow/particles, Flame interaction/audio remainder, reward/audio/effect/network dispatch and original GPU/resource owner remain pending.
